AccessDto.description: Who may sign in and who is admin: configuration rows first, then database rows, each by value.

AccessEntryDto.description: One allowed domain, allowed email or admin, from one source (kb/ADR-0015 R2).

allowed.description:
Meaningful only under `admins` (always true on domains, emails and configuration rows): false on an admin grant
whose email nothing allows, which grants nothing until the email is allowed again.

also_in_config.description: A database row that duplicates a configuration entry: listed separately and removable.

AccessSource.description: Where an entry comes from: the instance configuration (locked) or the database (editable by admins).

ActivityEntryDto.description: One row of the activity feed, as served on the wire.

attachments.description:
Uploads made while writing this text and still shown in it: they become this item's (kb/ADR-0022 R2). An id
that is gone is ignored; one that belongs to another item or person refuses the write.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen key that makes a retried comment safe: a repeat returns the thread with the first comment only.

AffectedStoryDto.description:
A story a decision affects: held by it (todo, in `blocks`) or started despite it (in `under_way`). The type name is
historical (it was `BlockedStoryDto` and held only `key` and `title`); it is JSON-compatible with that shape.

delivery.description: Servers always send it; JSON without it (an older server, whose blocks were all todo) reads as todo.

kind.description: Servers always send it; JSON without it (an older server) reads as a story.

needed_in.description: The story's own window: the earlier of its goals' and its promise's (kb/ADR-0025 R7). Servers always send it; JSON without it reads as `none`.

owner.description: Servers always send it; JSON without it reads as no owner.

urgent.description:
Urgent through lineage on the queue's snapshot (kb/ADR-0017 R3). Servers always send it; JSON without it
reads as false.

ApplyPlan.description:
Items refer to each other by their local `name`; a reference that is no name in the plan is an existing item's key
or external reference. The whole plan is validated before anything is written, and applying the same plan (`id`)
again creates nothing: every write is keyed `plan:<id>:<name>`. Unknown fields are refused, so a typo is an error,
not a silently dropped field.

id.description: Names this plan: the same id and names are the same items on a second apply.

content_type.description: The type its bytes identify: `image/png`, `image/jpeg` or `image/webp`.

oneOf.description: None while it is an upload not yet saved with any text (only its uploader sees it then).

url.description: Where the image is served; the one source of its path.

AttachmentOwnerDto.description: The item an attachment belongs to.

CheckResult.description: The outcome of the last record check on a required decision.

oneOf.description: The record's own `reversibility` (kb/ADR-0013 R2); absent from older checkers and records without it.

kind.description: `decided`: the reason says what was decided; `withdrawn`: why it is no longer needed (kb/ADR-0013 R3).

CloseSprint.description: Closes the active sprint; every goal needs a verdict.

oneOf.description: Decided or withdrawn (kb/ADR-0013 R3); absent on closes made before it.
The kind of token that closed it; absent on closes made before kb/ADR-0013.

ClosureKind.description: What a close says (kb/ADR-0013 R3): the decision was made, or it is no longer needed.

oneOf.description: Set when the comment is on an epic; absent from servers before it.
Set when the comment is on an initiative; absent from servers before it.

attachments.description:
Uploads made while writing this text and still shown in it: they become this item's (kb/ADR-0022 R2). An id
that is gone is ignored; one that belongs to another item or person refuses the write.

external_ref.description:
The item's origin elsewhere, e.g. the Jira key it was migrated from (`JPD-30`). It names one item across all
three types, and a later import of the same reference finds this item instead of creating another.

CreateGoal.description: Adds a goal to the draft, or to the active sprint with `active`. The owner defaults to the caller.

links.description:
Items the new goal links in its create, each a key; omitted means none. An unknown key refuses the whole create.
A replay of the idempotency key returns the goal as it now stands, unchanged by this call, whatever `links` it
sends.

CreateInitiative.description: Every create request carries a caller-supplied idempotency key; a repeat returns the same item.

attachments.description:

that is gone is ignored; one that belongs to another item or person refuses the write.

external_ref.description:

three types, and a later import of the same reference finds this item instead of creating another.

owner.description: The story's owner (email); it must be an allowed user.

CreatedGoalDto.description: `POST /goals`: the goal and its sprint's warnings after the add.

DecisionGateDto.description: An open, unsatisfied required decision: the item it is on and the readiness reason it gives (kb/ADR-0018 R3).

entries.description:
In page order: lanes in `QueueLane` declaration order, then server order within each lane. Clients must not
re-sort.

blocks.description: The todo stories whose readiness fails on this decision (held); empty outside the live lanes.

lane.description: The page lane. Servers always send it; JSON without it (an older server) reads as `open`.

needed_in.description: When the decision is needed. Servers always send it; JSON without it reads as `none`.

oneOf.description: Why it is needed this sprint or next; absent otherwise.
What the decision needs next; absent when closed or satisfied.

under_way.description:
Started stories the decision affects (in progress, in review or testing). Servers always send it; JSON without
it reads as none.

DecisionQueueSummaryDto.description: Counts over open, unsatisfied decisions only (except the lane sizes); `blocked_stories` counts each story once.

next_sprint.description: Size of the next-sprint lane; reads as 0 without it.

review.description: Size of the review lane. Servers always send it; JSON without it (an older server) reads as 0.

this_sprint.description: Size of the this-sprint lane; reads as 0 without it.

DemoStoryDto.description: A story completed in the window's last seven days (never before its start), oldest first.

DiscoveryGateDto.description: Shaped like `ItemRefDto` plus a title, so the client links it with `itemRoute`.

DoneFilter.description:
Which done stories `GET /stories` lists: every one (the default), only those that entered done within the
instance's `[board] done_window_days`, or none. Stories in other states are always listed.

EditDecision.description:
Edits a required decision's planner-side fields (kb/ADR-0004 R2). The record reference is set with `link`, the check
result by the checker; neither is accepted here, and any field not listed is refused rather than ignored.

decider.description: `null` leaves the decider unchanged, like absent (as in `EditItem`).

due.description: Some(None) clears the due date; None leaves it alone.

oneOf.description: Some(None) clears the classification; None leaves it alone.

title.description: `null` leaves the title unchanged, like absent (as in `EditItem`).

EditGoal.description: Each field is optional; an absent one is left as it is.

attachments.description:
Uploads made while writing this text and still shown in it: they become this item's (kb/ADR-0022 R2). An id
that is gone is ignored; one that belongs to another item or person refuses the write.

oneOf.description: Some(None) clears the epic; None leaves it alone.

external_ref.description:
Records the item's origin elsewhere once (the Jira key a hand-made item was migrated from), under the same rules
as on create; the reference it already has again is no change, and an existing one is never changed or cleared.

oneOf.description: An epic's parent: Some(None) clears the initiative; None leaves it alone.
A story's kind (story, bug, chore); None leaves it alone.

owner.description: Some(None) clears the owner; None leaves it alone.

target_month.description: Some(None) clears the target month; None leaves it alone.

Empty.description: The value of a response that carries nothing; serialises as `{}` and has a real schema component.

oneOf.description:
The epic's own promise, classified on read (kb/ADR-0025 R4–R5). Servers always send it; JSON without it (an
older server) reads as none.
The urgent mark stored on this item, active or expired (kb/ADR-0017). Servers always send it.

urgent_sources.description: The active marks that make this item urgent: its own first, then key-number order. Empty: not urgent.

EpicPromiseCleared.description: `DELETE /epics/{key}/promise`: whether this request cleared the epic's promise, and the epic as it is now.

EpicPromiseDto.description: An epic's own promise: no state (R4). `due` while the date is not past; `past` once it is.

EpicPromiseRefDto.description: The epic whose promise a story inherits, and that promise.

ExportDto.description:
The whole instance as one consistent snapshot (`GET /api/v1/export`): every list is read inside one
`REPEATABLE READ` transaction. Items order by key number, decisions, comments and activity by id, users by email.
Users carry emails and roles only; the export never holds token hashes, secrets or configuration.

attachments.description:
Every attachment an item owns, by upload time then id: metadata only; the bytes travel in the database dump
(kb/ADR-0022 R5). Uploads not yet saved with any text are left out.

sprints.description:
Every sprint, oldest first, with its goals (confidence, verdict, created_at) and their links nested. Not in the
DTOs: `created_at` of sprints and who linked what and when. The exported activity carries the goal's
`created` entry and each item's `goal_linked` entry (actor, time); a draft sprint's creation is not logged.

Finding.description:
Something worth a look on an initiative or an epic. Advisory: computed on read, never stored, and never consulted by
a move (kb/ADR-0027 keeps one gate, readiness). Shown by the CLI, the web and quoted by the planning skills.

oneOf.description: The brief is empty.

The brief cites Jira or Confluence, or says something was decided, and no required decision is on the item or
above it: a cited page or a "decided" is not a record anyone can check once the source is gone.
Discovery is marked complete while a required decision on the item is open and not satisfied.
Discovery is marked complete and nothing has been broken down under the item yet.

GoalContextDto.description: A goal the story serves, for story context: the goal, its sprint's dates and through which item.

created_at.description:
When the goal was created; the sprint page's "Waiting since" on a draft goal. Servers always send it; JSON
without it (an older server) reads as the Unix epoch.

links.description: The items linked to this goal, in key-number order; an epic or initiative link covers their stories.

oneOf.description: A draft from an agent or automation, waiting for a person to record or discard it (kb/ADR-0014 R5).

GoalGatesDto.description:
What one goal of the active or the draft sprint waits on (`GET /sprints/planning`), derived on read (kb/ADR-0014 R6,
kb/ADR-0018 R1). These are not sprint-membership counts: the kb/ADR-0014 R2 rule line does not go beside them.

decisions.description: By decision id. Each a `Reason::Decision*` variant, which carries the decision's id and title.

decisions_total.description: All the goal's decisions (withdrawn excluded); decided = total - decisions.len().

discoveries.description: Initiatives first, then epics, each by key number.

discovery_total.description: All the goal's initiatives and epics; marked = total - discoveries.len().

initiatives.description:
Each link's initiative (an initiative itself, an epic's, a story's epic's), once, in link order (links come by
key number); the sprint page groups the goal under the first.

GoalProgressDto.description: One goal's counts over a sprint's window (kb/ADR-0014 R2).

blocked_decisions.description:
Live: recomputed on every read from the decisions open now, even for a closed sprint. For a closed sprint, show
the value at close instead, from the `counts` in the sprint's `closed` activity entry; this one is today's.

GoalRefDto.description: One active-sprint goal a story serves, and through which item (the nearest link wins).

GoalVia.description: Through which item a story serves a goal.

ImportComment.description: A Jira comment, kept with its original author and date.

ImportInitiative.description:
A Jira initiative imported in its current state. `external_ref` is the Jira key and the idempotency
key: importing the same reference again creates nothing.

discovery_complete.description: Marks discovery complete, by the importing actor at import time.

ImportStory.description: A story created directly in its delivery state: no gate is consulted and no override is logged.

oneOf.description: Required exactly when `delivery` is done.

Imported.description:
`created` is false when the external reference already existed (create-only, re-runnable). Items carry `key`,
comments carry `id`.

progress.description: completed / not-dropped; None when nothing counts yet

oneOf.description: The urgent mark stored on this item, active or expired (kb/ADR-0017). Servers always send it.

urgent_sources.description: The active marks that make this item urgent: its own first, then key-number order. Empty: not urgent.

InstanceConfigDto.description: What the client needs from instance configuration (kb/ADR-0016 R2): never hardcoded in the client.

done_window_days.description: `[board] done_window_days`: how far back `done=recent` reaches. Absent from servers before this field existed (deserialises as 0, meaning unknown).

import_enabled.description: `[import] enabled`: the import endpoints answer 404 unless this is true.

IssuedTokenDto.description: The secret is shown once; the server stores only its hash.

ItemRefDto.description: An item named with its type: keys share one sequence (kb/ADR-0002 R5), so a key alone does not say what it is.

LinkGoal.description: Items to link, each a key or external reference of any level.

MarkUrgent.description: Mark (or renew) an item urgent; the reason is optional, at most 200 characters.

NeededIn.description:
When an open, unsatisfied decision is needed, derived on read from goals, discovery and the promises of the stories it
affects (never stored, kb/ADR-0014 R6, kb/ADR-0025 R7). The variant order is the order of urgency, earliest first:
the queue takes the earliest of several windows with `min`, so the variants must not be reordered.

NeededInReason.description:
Why a decision is needed this sprint or next. Clients must accept `unknown`: a later server may send a reason
this build does not know.

oneOf.description: An affected story serves this goal (of the active sprint for `this_sprint`, the draft one for `next_sprint`).

The decision's item, or an ancestor, is in discovery under the first horizon bucket. `level` says whether `key` is an
initiative or an epic, so a client can link to it. It defaults to `initiative` when absent, so a payload from before
the field existed still parses; a discovery item is never a story.

An affected story is promised (kb/ADR-0025 R7); `key`/`level` name the item holding the promise (the story, or
the epic it inherits from), `on` the effective date, and `overdue` whether that date has passed unfinished.
A reason added after this client was built.

NextStep.description: What an open, unsatisfied decision needs next. The first that holds wins, in declaration order.

OpenSprint.description:
Opens the draft; the end defaults to one `[sprints] length_days` after today. `leave_out` names draft goals that stay
in the next draft (kb/ADR-0026); empty or absent opens every goal.

PlanApplied.description:
What the plan came to: every item and decision by its local name, with `created` false when an earlier apply of
this plan had made it, and every blocker edge with `created` false when it was already there.

PlanBlock.description: `blocked_by` blocks `story`; each is a plan story's name or an existing story's key.

on.description: A plan item's name, or an existing item's key.

oneOf.description: One-way or two-way; absent leaves it unset (kb/ADR-0013 R1).

initiative.description: A plan initiative's name, or an existing initiative's key.

oneOf.description:
The state of the migrated ticket: todo when absent. Any state needs `external_ref`; one other than
todo is created in that state and logged `imported`, as the importer does, never `override`. Done is the
importer's alone (it needs a resolution).

epic.description: A plan epic's name, or an existing epic's key.

oneOf.description: story when absent.

PrStatus.description: A pull request's state as GitHub last reported it; a cache, never a driver of delivery.

PromiseDue.description: An open promise's due period against the sprints' planned ends, derived on read (R5).

PromiseFactDto.description: A stored promise (kb/ADR-0025 R1): the date, who set it, when, and an optional recipient.

PromiseHolder.description: Whose promise sets a story's effective date: its own, or its epic's (R3; the story's own wins a tie).

PromiseShortcut.description: A sprint whose planned end a promise takes (R6): the active sprint or the draft (next) one.

PromiseState.description: A story's promise state, derived on read (R4).

PromisedFilter.description:
The story list's `promised` filter (kb/ADR-0025 R5, kb/ADR-0021): `this_sprint` keeps overdue promises and open
ones due this sprint, `next_sprint` open ones due next sprint, `overdue` only overdue ones, `any` every open or
overdue promise. Kept, late and dropped promises never match.

QueueGroup.description: Where a decision sits in the queue; the declaration order is the page order.

QueueLane.description: The queue lane the web groups by; declaration order is the page order. Lanes are disjoint.

RankStory.description:
Places a todo story before `before` (another todo story), or at the end of the todo column when `before` is absent.
The server renumbers the column's ranks 0..n-1 in one write; only the moved story's version changes, because rank is
ordering metadata, not content an editor guards on.

Reason.description:
Why a story is blocked, or why a move was refused: a readiness fact, which an interactive override may get past, or a
delivery rule, which nothing will. `Reason::overridable` (and a refusal's `overridable`) says which.

oneOf.description: The record is in a repository the server does not check yet; it is checked once the repository is configured.

A blocking story that is unfinished for this story (kb/ADR-0027 R5), with what decides when it unblocks: its
delivery (merged, it blocks nobody) and its owner (who can build on it, or whom to ask).
A sprint is already active; close it first.
Closing needs a verdict on every goal.
Only an interactive user may do this (kb/ADR-0014 R5).

RecordCheckResult.description: The check names the record it checked and the decision version it observed, so an out-of-order check never overwrites a relink; the server refuses a result for a reference that has since changed (kb/ADR-0004 R3).

RecordConfidence.description:
A person's confidence (`POST /goals/{id}/confidence`, interactive only) or a suggestion for one
(`POST /goals/{id}/suggestion`, any token kind).

browse_url.description:
Where to read the record in a browser, `<repo url>/blob/HEAD/<path>`; the server derives it from the repository's
`https://` URL in `[[repos]]` and leaves it out when there is none (never stored, kb/ADR-0004 R1). Absent
in JSON from an older server.

oneOf.description: One-way or two-way; absent leaves it unset (kb/ADR-0013 R1).

on_type.description: The level of the item `on` names; one key sequence (kb/ADR-0002 R5) means the key alone does not say.

oneOf.description: One-way or two-way; unset behaves as two-way (kb/ADR-0013 R1).

value.description: Who may sign in and who is admin: configuration rows first, then database rows, each by value.

overridable.description:

with an override reason. False when any reason is a delivery rule. Absent (an older server) reads as false.

current.description:
On a `conflict`: the row's version now, or -1 for a concurrent update with no version to give (a retried
serialisation failure, or a goal an opening moved); re-read and retry. Absent otherwise.
